college.name: Greater Noida Institute of Technology (GNIOT)
college.location: Plot No. 7, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201306, India
college.metro: Walking distance from Knowledge Park II Metro Station
college.affiliation: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow

branches: Computer Science and Engineering - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (CSE AI & ML)
Computer Science and Engineering - Artificial Intelligence (CSE AI)
Computer Science and Engineering - Data Science (CSE DS)
Computer Science and Engineering - Cyber Security
Computer Science and Engineering - Internet of Things (CSE IoT)

hostel.availability: Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls.
hostel.location: Close to the academic block within the campus

fees.note: University enrollment and semester examination fees may be paid separately through the university portal when demanded.

admission.minimum_qualification: 10+2/intermediate or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and one optional subject as specified by GNIOT.
admission.minimum_marks: 45% in the specified subjects, 40% for SC/ST candidates
admission.lateral_entry: 3-year duration for eligible Diploma in Engineering or B.Sc. with Mathematics candidates.

accreditation.nba: NBA accreditation for CSE, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Information Technology programs
